title: Volvo Trucks North America: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (2,835 affected)
summary: DOOR LATCH PAWL SPRING WAS NOT DESIGNED TO SPECIFICATION. DOOR COULD OPEN WITHOUT WARNING OR DOOR LATCH MAY NOT CATCH PROPERLY WHEN DOOR IS CLOSED.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: STEERING:COLUMN LOCKING:ANTI-THEFT DEVICE (4,895 affected)
summary: BUZZER WAS NOT INSTALLED TO REMIND DRIVER TO REMOVE THE IGNITION KEY WHEN LEAVING THE VEHICLE. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 114, "THEFT PROTECTION".

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (520 affected)
summary: RUBBER FUEL HOSE COULD ALLOW A SLOW FUEL LEAK WHILE THE ENGINE IS RUNNING.

title: Ford Motor Company: SUSPENSION (19 affected)
summary: WEIGHT RATING INFORMATION IS INCORRECT ON VEHICLE MANUAL LABELS AND RATING DECALS.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:HOUSING:AXLE SHAFT (62 affected)
Ford Motor Company: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN (13,500 affected)
summary: FAN BLADES AND ARMS MAY CRACK AND CHIP, DURING NORMAL VEHICLE SERVICE.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83) (37,000 affected)
summary: POSITIONING OF THE ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD RESULT IN ABNORMAL WEAR TO THE CABLE. THE CABLE COULD BEGIN TO FRAY AND UNWIND.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:CONTROL VALVE (4,748 affected)
summary: WATER CONTROL VALVE IN THE HEATING SYSTEM MAY NOT CLOSE COMPLETELY. EXCESSIVE CURRENT MAY BEGIN TO FLOW THROUGH THE WIRING TO THE CONTROL VALVE RESULTING IN OVERHEATING OF THE WIRING.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (74,275 affected)
summary: OIL PRESSURE SENDER GAUGE MAY BE DEFECTIVE. CONTINUED ENGINE OPERATION UNDER HIGH TEMPERATURE AND HIGH PRESSURE MAY CAUSE THE SENDING UNIT TO LEAK OIL OR MAY CAUSE THE ENGINE TO LOCK UP.

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES:LINER (2,351 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES, ENDURANCE TESTS.

title: GCE IMPORT & EXPORT CORP.: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BACK UP LIGHTS (8 affected)
summary: BACK-UP LIGHTS, ALTHOUGH VISIBLE AND FUNCTIONAL, FAILED TO MEET THE ILLUMINATION STANDARDS SET IN FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: STEERING:LINKAGES (13,200 affected)
summary: THE STEERING ARM MAY CRACK OR BREAK IN EITHER LOW SPEED OR STAND STILL MANEUVERS. CRACKING MAY OCCUR AS A RESULT OF REPEATED FULL LOCK TURNS.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR (176 affected)
summary: THESE TRUCKS WERE EQUIPPED WITH DEFECTIVE HYDRAULIC PRESSURE SWITCHES IN THE LOAD SPAN TAG SYSTEM. WHEN A MALFUNCTION IN THIS SYSTEM OCCURS, AXLE TO PAVEMENT PRESSURE INCREASES WHEN VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN AN UNLOADED CONDITION.

title: Allison Transmission, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:SEAT WARMER (3,936 affected)
summary: SEAT WARMER MAY SHORT CIRCUIT OR OVERHEAT DUE TO MANUFACTURING DEFECT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STRUCTURE:SHIELDS:PROTECTORS:LINES:TUBING (8,800 affected)
summary: VEHICLES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE IMPACT TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY." THE STRUCTURE OF THE REAR STEP BUMPER MAY NOT WITHSTAND A REAR END COLLISION SIMILAR TO THE FORCE CREATED IN TESTING; FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR UPON IMPACT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL:VALVE (2,385 affected)
summary: AN EMISSIONS SYSTEM VALVE MAY ALLOW AN OVERLY RICH MIXTURE (EXCESSIVE FUEL) IN THE ENGINE DURING DECELERATION. THE MIXTURE OF AIR AND EXCESSIVE FUEL CAN CAUSE THE ENGINE TO STALL WHILE STOPPING, COASTING, OR TURNING.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (682 affected)
summary: THE FRONT BRAKE HOSE, WHICH IS ROUTED FROM THE BODY BRAKE TUBING TO THE FRONT AXLE CONNECTOR, MAY HAVE BEEN TWISTED WHEN INSTALLED. IF THE HOSE IS TWISTED, IT MAY BECOME LOOPED OR COILED UPON ITSELF RESULTING IN ABRASIVE CONTACT DURING NORMAL OPERATION.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: BRAKES:AIR:OVER:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM:DISC (405 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE BOLTS ATTACHING THE BRAKE ASSEMBLY TO THE AXLE MAY FRACTURE WITHOUT WARNING. IF ONE OR MORE OF THESE BOLTS FRACTURE, IT MAY RESULT IN REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLY DAMAGE AND BRAKE INEFFECTIVENESS ON THE REAR AXLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (460,918 affected)
summary: SECONDARY HOOD LATCH COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY POSITIONED DURING ASSEMBLY. IF THE HOOD IS NOT CLOSED TIGHTLY, OR IS INADVERTENTLY RELEASED, THE SECONDARY LATCH MAY NOT WORK AND THE HOOD MAY FLY UP WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (192,742 affected)
summary: THE FLEXIBLE HOSE CONNECTING THE FUEL PUMP TO THE CARBURETOR FUEL LINE MAY SEPARATE FROM THE FUEL PUMP.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (2,303 affected)
summary: THE SLEEPER COMPARTMENT INSIDE DOOR LATCHING MECHANISMS MAY CAUSE THE DOOR TO UNLATCH WHILE THE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN.
